notes:
• Brand-new ribbon interface. Tools are now organised into clear tabs across the top — Home, Convert, Cameras and Help — each holding only the tools for that job, grouped and labelled. The old crowded rows of buttons are gone.
• Home has your files and the Camera Grid. Convert has every MP4 setting in one place. Cameras has Find Cameras and the folder survey. Help gathers the tutorial, shortcuts, what's-new and updates.
• The play controls — timeline, play, rewind, frame step, speed, trim marks, snapshot, full screen and sound — stay along the bottom at all times, always to hand whichever tab you're on.
